name: Curly Lionfish 0
author: AKHILJITH-VN
description: Gradient rounded teal button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(30deg,#20fcfc,#6565ff
    ,#feb7c4,#e011e0) to linear-gradient(30deg,#e011e0, #ffc0cb, #3c3cff, #20fcfc), box-shadow becomes 2px 4px 6px #a8097e.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Curly Lionfish 0</title>
<style>
/* Curly Lionfish 0 by AKHILJITH-VN — https://uiverse.io/AKHILJITH-VN/curly-lionfish-0 */
button {
  height: auto;
  width: auto;
  text-align: justify;
  background: linear-gradient(30deg,rgb(32, 252, 252),rgb(101, 101, 255)
    ,rgb(254, 183, 196),rgb(224, 17, 224));
  color: #ffffff;
  border: none;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 2px 4px 6px #25d0e3;
  transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(30deg,rgb(224, 17, 224), pink, rgb(60, 60, 255), rgb(32, 252, 252));
  box-shadow: 2px 4px 6px #a8097e;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
